This work is never complete, but it is always necessary.

May I always choose to listen as if what is being shared matters, to speak as if my words carry weight, and to live as if each day is an opportunity to embody the balance between solitude and community that sustains us all.

Your faith is strengthened not by certainty alone, but by the courage to trust in God's grace when your own strength falters.

You have found that forgiveness is an expression of strength, not weakness, and that this strength is rooted in the belief that every person is worthy of love. Hold this conviction close, especially in times when the world seems unjust or indifferent. Your own journey has been one of learning to balance truth and tenderness, and this balance is what allows love to endure without losing its integrity.

As you continue, remember that your confession is not a solitary act but part of a shared human story—one in which Tradition, community, and divine grace sustain you.
